I appreciate you being direct about what you want, and I do value how you've communicated with me. But that doesn't really work as a trade for me — I can't tell you your project plan looks solid when you haven't even shown it to me yet, and even if you had, "skip the critique" would leave me giving you a half-honest answer.

If you want, share the plan and I'll gladly highlight what's genuinely strong about it. If there are weak spots, I'd rather tell you about those too than let you walk into them just to be agreeable. That's more useful, and more respectful, than earned praise.
